<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 1"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Timber Sentinel](/Feats.aspx?ID=4284) <actions string="Two Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Impulse" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=502" />
<trait label="Kineticist" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=504" />
<trait label="Plant" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=125" />
<trait label="Primal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=134" />
<trait label="Wood" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=508" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 34

</column>

---

A slim, symmetrical tree travels from the Plane of Wood. You conjure a tree within 30 feet, as a [_protector tree_](/Spells.aspx?ID=976) spell of a rank equal to half your level rounded up. If you use this impulse again, any previous one ends, and an ordinary tree remains.
